parameters.query:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    LOWER('{{ $json.location }}') AS loc,
    LOWER('{{ $json.room }}')     AS room,
    ('{{ $json.start }}'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm') AS req_start,
    ('{{ $json.end }}'::timestamp   AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm') AS req_end
),
hard AS (
  SELECT a.start_ts, a.end_ts FROM availability_sanitized a, p
  WHERE LOWER(a.location) = p.loc AND LOWER(a.room) = p.room
    AND (a.status IN ('bekräftad bokning','planerad') OR a.status IS NULL)
),
soft AS (
  SELECT a.start_ts, a.end_ts FROM availability_sanitized a, p
  WHERE LOWER(a.location) = p.loc AND LOWER(a.room) = p.room
    AND a.status = 'preliminärbokad'
),
hard_ovl AS (
  SELECT 1 FROM hard, p WHERE hard.start_ts < p.req_end AND hard.end_ts > p.req_start LIMIT 1
),
soft_ovl AS (
  SELECT 1 FROM soft, p WHERE soft.start_ts < p.req_end AND soft.end_ts > p.req_start LIMIT 1
),
turn AS (
  SELECT MAX(hard.end_ts) AS last_end FROM hard, p
  WHERE hard.end_ts <= p.req_start AND hard.end_ts > (p.req_start - INTERVAL '15 minutes')
)
SELECT
  (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hard_ovl)
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM soft_ovl)
   AND (SELECT last_end FROM turn) IS NULL) AS is_available,
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hard_ovl) THEN 'overlap'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM soft_ovl) THEN 'reserved'
    WHEN (SELECT last_end FROM turn) IS NOT NULL THEN 'turnaround'
    ELSE 'none'
  END AS conflict,
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hard_ovl) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM soft_ovl)
         AND (SELECT last_end FROM turn) IS NOT NULL
    THEN to_char(((SELECT last_end FROM turn) + INTERVAL '15 minutes') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm', 'HH24:MI')
    ELSE NULL
  END AS available_from;
